limitations: Preference ranks are frozen AI annotations, not human preferences.
Semantic features are actual Gemini API outputs; no LLM fine-tuning is performed.
Agreement with AI labels does not establish customer satisfaction or production quality.
Synthetic catalog; scenario groups are disjoint but products are shared across splits.
Missing coordinates produce zero proximity; distance preferences cannot be learned.
Ineligible Gemini results are excluded; evaluation counts may differ from the earlier experiment.
